forbid.message: React registers wheel listeners as passive, so preventDefault() does nothing and a stopPropagation() opt-out never reaches a native listener. Register a native listener with addEventListener("wheel", h, { passive: false }) in an effect, and opt children out with data-wheel-zoom-ignore (TPL-1537).

paths.message: Import test from a fixture (opfs.js, serve.js or network.js) and expect from a fixture or fixtures/expect.js. That expect refuses an assertion timeout above the default (packages/e2e/fixtures/expect.ts, TPL-1171). Types such as Page may still come from @playwright/test.

patterns.message: Do not import a barrel (any index.js or extensionless index, nested ones included) inside packages/core/src: import the module by its own path (e.g. ./parser/parser.js), since a barrel import creates runtime cycles. Test files (*.test.ts, *.spec.ts) may import ../index.js.
